name: Autonomous Bug Triage & Auto-Remediation Coordinator
description: Enterprise-grade autonomous bug triage and remediation agent for Google ADK 2.0 and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform. Performs automated log sanitization, Cloud DLP PII scrubbing, vector deduplication, CODEOWNERS routing, pytest sandbox reproduction, and HITL gated pull request synthesis.

skills.name: log-sanitization-dlp
skills.description: Sanitizes crash logs, extracts stack frames, and redacts PII via Google Cloud Sensitive Data Protection.

skills.name: vector-deduplication
skills.description: Identifies duplicate defect tickets via vector cosine similarity matching.

skills.name: ownership-routing
skills.description: Resolves microservice code ownership via .github/CODEOWNERS and git blame; assigns SLA priorities.

skills.name: sandbox-remediation
skills.description: Synthesizes pytest reproduction unit tests and verified unified diff patches in an ephemeral sandbox.

skills.name: hitl-pull-request
skills.description: Renders A2UI review cards with 'The Vibe Diff' and opens GitHub draft pull requests upon developer signoff.
